title: phpolars
summary: Query and transform data with Polars from PHP. Use eager data frames, or build lazy queries with expressions, with an API that follows py-polars: DataFrame, LazyFrame, Series, joins, time series windows, SQL, and readers and writers for CSV, Parquet, JSON, Arrow IPC, and PDO. PIE installs the phpstats/phpolars package as the php_polars extension. phibble's PolarsTable uses the extension to run phibble tables and phplyr pipelines in Polars.

verify.note: PHP-FPM reads its own php.ini, so enable the extension there and restart FPM.
